basis: PREREG_H1_TF chair ruling on F12e (a); F12.3; F12a.2(i); F5 schema pins 'Gauge audit'

construction.Q: H diag(d); H Haar r x r: torch.Generator('cpu').manual_seed(seed('20261110:lol-gauge:', '<row id>:<exact tensor name>')), randn(r, r) fp64, QR with positive diagonal (zero sign -> +1); d_j = 2^((j mod 3) - 1), j = 0..r-1 (chair ruling on F12f (b)); r = recorded rank capped at min(out, in) (frozen r_eff); at r = 1, Q = 1/2 exactly, so (B/2, 2A) is exact in floating point and the token is bitwise unchanged
construction.edit_id: the population row id (the canonical zoo edit id); alias rows keep their own id
construction.factors: balanced B = U_r diag(sigma_r^1/2), A = diag(sigma_r^1/2) V_r^T of the full thin fp32 SVD of D_t (f12_tokens.balanced_factors); (B, A) -> (BQ, Q^-1 A) in fp64 (Q^-1 = diag(1/d) H^T), cast to fp32
construction.scope: every population row and every present token (each present token has balanced low-rank factors); absent slots stay zero
construction.source_checks: token manifest sha256 pinned; token files equal its sha256; population sha256; slot names; base state hash; per-row increment sha256 equals the frozen rows.jsonl; presence equals the nonzero supported tensors; r_eff equals the frozen detail; the recomputed K block reproduces the frozen columns 0-15 bitwise (frozen run's six threads)
construction.token: frozen token with columns 0-15 replaced by the K block of the transformed factors (frozen K frames); columns 16-41 copied (functions of D_t alone); masked K blocks stay zero

outcomes_read: none: the frozen token outputs (verified), population.json, stored edit bytes and the base model only; no evaluation record, TF-v1 score, noise payload or data/evals file
